palette: ochre umber hall, bronze credit rails, teal pay lane, rust rescind lane, bone paper, walnut ink
typography: credit-hall headings on umber rail tabs, bone chips with bronze seals
composition: a credit hall where the trial cycle forks three exit gates, the installment gauge snaps at the one-fifth mark into pay and rescind lanes, the retention loop carries goods back through retrieval redemption and resale, and a parallel ledger contrasts the two repayment regimes
surface: bone paper dossiers, umber desk rails, bronze credit stamps
motion: trial goods sit with the tester until an exit gate flips them, the installment gauge fills to one fifth and forks two repayment lanes, retained-title goods travel back to the seller through retrieval then fork to redemption or resale, and the ledger rows light in contrast pairs
transition: the ochre hall floor, umber rails and bronze stamp posts persist while gates, gauges, loops and ledgers are re-dressed between scenes
